vibe-learn 1.0.0 — Initial Release

- Introduces a micro-learning knowledge feed for developers waiting on AI coding agents.
- Automatically detects idle/waiting states and delivers 4–6 curated knowledge cards relevant to the user's current coding context.
- Uses conversation history to pinpoint languages, frameworks, and topics for adjacent learning opportunities.
- Presents cards as a React artifact with high-quality, scannable UI, following frontend-design principles.
- Generates a matching standalone HTML page for browser reading/bookmarking.
- Dynamically adapts content language (Chinese/English) based on user context.
